card.name: "or" after a length of time
card.fires_on: The word "or" right after a stated time span (hours, weeks, months) where the text goes on to say "longer", "until" or "while". Also "the" or "flight" just before "longest".

modes.label: "or" after a time span
modes.description: "or" follows a number of hours, weeks or months in monitoring or treatment-length advice, before "longer", "until" or "while".
modes.example: monitoring of patients after overdose with eletriptan should continue for at least 20 hours<< or>> longer while symptoms or signs persist.

modes.label: Before "longest"
modes.description: "the" or "flight" sits just before "longest" in a sentence about how long a seed stays aloft.
modes.example: The cottonwood tree seed is the seed that stays in flight<< the>> longest.

card.writes: It suppresses words about length of time such as prolonged, longer and duration, so the model is less inclined to say them next.
card.plain: It fires on the "or" after a span like "2 weeks or", where the text is about to say "longer" or "until".
